_doc.source: DESIGN.md §7 — pinned WD-SRS trajectory with fuzz disabled; consumed by backend/tests/unit/test_srs.py (WP4) and frontend utils/srsPreview test (WP8)
_doc.trajectory: start from a fresh `new` row (ease 2.5, interval 0, step 0, repetitions 0, consecutive_good 0) and apply grades[i] in order; after grade i the row has intervals[i], eases[i], steps[i] and GradeResponse.next_due_zh == next_due_zh[i]. Step 0 is the first exposure graded good → the 10-minute learning step (interval still 0); step 1 graduates to 1 day; mastery_suggested becomes true from index mastery_suggested_from_step on (interval ≥ 30, consecutive_good ≥ 3, step 0).
_doc.lapse: apply the trajectory up to and including index lapse.after_step (the 20-day step: ease 2.55, consecutive_good 4, repetitions 5), then grade lapse.grades in order: `again` in the review phase lapses (lapses+1, ease 2.55→2.35, consecutive_good 0, relearning step, interval kept at 20), the following `good` on the step graduates with interval max(1, rnd(20 × 0.5)) = 10 days.

humanize._doc: GradeResponse.next_due_zh thresholds (API.md §9.1): step 1 → '10 分钟后'; interval 1 → '明天'; 2–59 → 'N 天后'; ≥ 60 → '约 M 个月后' with M = rnd(interval/30) half-up; master → '已掌握'; skip → '已跳过'; screen unfamiliar without a same-day study row → '明天'
